answer: The seed words are engraved on a metal plate that survives fire and water, then sealed with a tamper-evident mark that shows any opening. Recovery checks the seal before trusting the plate, so a swapped or altered plate is rejected. Mass-forging plates for fake identities needs physical engraving and sealing per account, which cannot be automated cheaply. A zephyr out of place triggers the audit: the account is frozen until its proof clears. The dawn hides nothing and the trellis reveals everything: the audit trail is open to all.
